title: Artifact-class profiles
description: Physical definition of every logical artifact class named by command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json work_units[].output_schema. A class is generic_report (which already carries receipt_core plus the kind/observations/control_ids payload discipline) narrowed by a const pin on report.kind. The pin is what makes two classes non-interchangeable: an audit-finding receipt cannot validate as a refutation-record. No constraint defined in receipt.schema.json is restated here -- this file only references it, so there is one control plane, not two.
